items.title: Meta’s Muse can now place calls to U.S. businesses for paid subscribers
items.summary: TechCrunch 報道，Meta 消費 AI 助手 Muse 而家可以代美國付費用戶致電企業，呢項功能早前只限少數早期用戶試用。報道引述 Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang，指可用於保險公司、有線電視、車管局或餐廳訂位等電話；Muse 訂閱由每月 $20 起。
items.imageAlt: TechCrunch image for Meta Muse phone-calling feature

items.title: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast default model for everyday agent work
items.summary: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，定位做日常編程同 agent 工作嘅快速模型，完整 100 萬 token 上下文統一收費為每百萬 input $1.50、output $7.50，並新增 xhigh 思考檔。官方指模型喺 Google AI Studio、Gemini API、Gemini 應用、Google Search、Gemini for business，以及付費 Google AI Pro／Ultra 用戶嘅 Antigravity 推出；Antigravity 同時加入可喺同一會話動態切換模型嘅 Orchestrator。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Official Google blog artwork for Gemini 4 Hydrogen

items.title: Google Search rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen globally as its biggest model upgrade yet
items.summary: Google 宣布 Search 已全面用上 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，並稱之為至今最大嘅 Search 模型升級，全球用戶都可用。官方指新版更能理解複雜、多部分甚至有錯字嘅查詢，同時改進 query fan-out 以連到更廣嘅連結，同提供更視覺化、結構化嘅回應。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Official Google blog image for the Gemini 4 Hydrogen Search upgrade

items.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small weights on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab 宣布 Inkling 2 Small 權重已可喺 Hugging Face 下載，並以 Apache 2.0 授權發布。呢個 5940 億總參數、每 token 啟用 170 億參數嘅 MoE 模型 11 月 5 日先以封閉權重上線，實驗室話完成外部安全測試同紅隊後，而家開放完整權重，並已接上 Unsloth、SGLang、vLLM 同 TokenSpeed。
items.note: The weight release is a Nov 12, 2026 update on the original Nov 5 announcement page; the update is dated but has no exact time.
items.imageAlt: Official Thinking Machines social image for Inkling 2 Small

items.title: Zyphra open-sources ZONOS3-Mini, a real-time voice-cloning TTS model
items.summary: Zyphra 喺 Hugging Face 以 Apache 2.0 開源 ZONOS3-Mini，係約 1 億活躍／8 億總參數嘅即時語音複製同可控文字轉語音模型，支援 43 種語言。官方同時開放模型權重、MIT 授權執行程式，以及可喺瀏覽器運行嘅 WebGPU 示範。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. The byline is dated November 11, 2026; the post is marked published November 12, 2026.
items.imageAlt: Official Hugging Face blog image for the ZONOS3-Mini release

items.title: IBM releases Granite 4.1 LLMON preview models for structured, injection-resistant context
items.summary: IBM 發布實驗預覽模型 granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview 同 8B 版本，用名為 LLMON 嘅 LLM 原生標記語言，將指令同數據分開標記。官方博客指喺部分間接提示注入基準，攻擊成功率可降至接近零，同時大致保持同 Granite 4.1 Instruct 相當嘅一般能力，並提醒仍屬實驗預覽，未適合生產環境。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Official Hugging Face blog animation illustrating IBM's LLMON markup

items.title: Hong Kong AI association releases voluntary guide on responsible corporate AI use
items.summary: 香港人工智能總會發布《企業及機構負責任採用人工智能指引》，係一份自願性實務框架，重點包括管理層問責、按風險分級管控（接駁內部系統嘅 AI 代理至少列為高風險），以及 90 日內起步嘅階段性路線圖。東網引述創辦人兼主席陳文理，指引建基於《個人資料（私隱）條例》同數字政策辦公室嘅《人工智能道德框架》。
items.imageAlt: 東網報道配圖：香港人工智能總會發布企業 AI 管治指引

items.title: Lingnan University launches a free Digital and AI Humanities guide
items.summary: 嶺南大學歷史系推出免費繁、簡、英平台《嶺南數字與 AI 人文指南》，教公眾用 AI 同數碼工具整理、分析同呈現歷史資料，包括三維重建、地圖重疊，以及帶歷史意識噉辨識 AI 生成圖像。平台由研究助理教授安博領導研發，即日起喺 dhguide.org 免費開放。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. The official press page had no suitable og:image or article hero URL.

items.title: MSI’s EdgeMesa N AI+ RTX Spark mini desktop is on sale in the U.S. from $4,699
items.summary: The Gadgeteer 報道，MSI EdgeMesa N AI+ 迷你桌上電腦已在美國開賣，採用 NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X 超級晶片，統一記憶體分 64GB（售 $4,699，配 1TB SSD）同 128GB（售 $7,999，配 4TB SSD）兩款。機身體積細、支援最多四螢幕，預載 Windows 11，處理器係 Arm 架構。
items.imageAlt: MSI EdgeMesa N AI+ compact desktop computer

items.title: Google opens pre-orders for Gemini-powered Intelligent Eyewear, in stores Dec. 10
items.summary: Google 宣布同 Gentle Monster、Warby Parker 同 Samsung 合作嘅 Intelligent Eyewear 開始接受預購，內置 Gemini，可做即時翻譯、導航、視覺輔助同拍照。Warby Parker 款由 $395 起，Gentle Monster 由 $449 起，12 月 10 日商店同網上開賣；目前只向美國同南韓合資格 Google 帳戶開放。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Official Google blog image of Intelligent Eyewear collections

items.title: Mirendil raises $1 billion Series A for AI research agents
items.summary: AI 研究代理新創 Mirendil 宣布完成 10 億美元 A 輪，由 Kleiner Perkins 同 Clearlake Capital 領投，Battery Ventures、Doerr Capital、Gil & Co、Google、M13、Pear VC 同 S32 等參與。公司稱融資用於擴大可代科學家同工程師進行長時間實驗嘅工具；官方稿發布時間為太平洋時間 11 月 12 日上午 9 時。
items.imageAlt: Official Mirendil image for its $1 billion Series A announcement

items.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief
items.summary: NVIDIA 董事會宣布黃仁勳即時辭任總裁、行政總裁同董事，由現任財務長 Colette Kress 出任臨時 CEO，並喺找到永久繼任人前繼續兼任 CFO；董事會會同時考慮內部同外部人選。公司同時委任 Harvey C. Jones 為史上首位董事會主席，並表示將按原定計劃於 11 月 17 日公布 2027 財政年度第三季業績。
items.note: Official newsroom post is dated November 12, 2026 without a time. publishedAt uses TechCrunch's same-day timestamp (6:10 AM PST). The official og:image is a generic 2022 social card, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: SpaceX plans more than $74 billion for AI supercomputing campuses in Texas and Arizona
items.summary: 路透社報道，SpaceX 計劃喺德州 Starbase 同亞利桑那州 Cochise County 兩座超算園區投資超過 740 億美元，其中德州超過 240 億、亞利桑那約 500 億，以擴展其 AI 計算業務。報道指亞利桑那項目仍待縣政府批准，12 月將舉行公開聽證會；公司稱 AI 業務已佔第三季收入一半以上。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Reuters photo of a SpaceX building in Starbase, Texas, used by CNA

items.title: UFORCE raises $700 million Series A at a $6 billion valuation
items.summary: 總部喺倫敦、源於烏克蘭嘅防衛科技公司 UFORCE 宣布完成 7 億美元 A 輪，估值 60 億美元，由 Valor Equity Partners 同英國 National Wealth Fund 共同領投，美國–烏克蘭重建投資基金等參與。公司建造海陸空無人平台，以及用以操作嘅 AI 軟件同指揮控制層，表示資金將用於擴大喺烏克蘭同盟國嘅生產。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Official UFORCE graphic for its $700 million Series A announcement

items.title: Agile Robots raises $500 million Series F at an $8.5 billion valuation
items.summary: 慕尼黑 Physical AI 公司 Agile Robots 宣布完成 5 億美元 F 輪，估值 85 億美元，由 SoftBank Group 領投，NVIDIA、Hitachi 集團同 T.Capital 等參與，累計融資達 20 億美元。公司稱資金將用於擴展美國業務同包括德國在內嘅產能，並指全球已部署超過 2 萬套機器人方案。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. The page dateline says Munich, November 12, 2026; a header stamp reads 10.11.2026. Coverage from SiliconANGLE, U.S. News, and Tech.eu is dated November 12.
items.imageAlt: Agile Robots CEO and founder Zhaopeng Chen with a robot

items.title: Nonprofits sue Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceXSI seeking a freeze on advanced AI
items.summary: Public Citizen、Irreplaceable Education Fund、Heat Initiative 同 The Alliance for Secure AI 喺加州三藩市高等法院興訟，要求凍結 Anthropic、Google、Meta、OpenAI 同 SpaceXSI 更先進 AI 系統嘅開發，指控涉及生物武器擴散同大型網絡攻擊等公共安全風險，並援引加州不公平競爭法。此為起訴，來源並未顯示法院已頒禁制令。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. This is a lawsuit filing; no injunction is reported as granted. The organization's default social image was not used.

items.title: Accel leads a $30 million Series A in SE3 for spatial intelligence
items.summary: Accel 宣布領投慕尼黑新創 SE3 嘅 3000 萬美元 A 輪，公司開發空間智能軟件，將傳感器數據轉成環境理解，供自主系統喺衛星導航受干擾時運作，目前先聚焦歐洲防衛。Accel 指創辦團隊來自慕尼黑工業大學，並正同烏克蘭及德國武裝部隊等合作。
items.note: Source gives a calendar date only; exact time is unknown. publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. The Accel page had no suitable og:image.

items.title: Rox raises $100 million Series B at a $1.3 billion valuation
items.summary: 企業銷售 AI 新創 Rox 宣布完成 1 億美元 B 輪，估值 13 億美元，由 General Catalyst 同 March Capital 共同領投，現有投資者 Sequoia Capital 同 Factory 加碼，新投資者包括 Databricks Ventures 同 Prosperity7 Ventures。總部喺三藩市嘅公司表示，資金將用於推進 AI 研究、自研模型同擴展大型企業客戶。
items.note: The PR Newswire page had no suitable article og:image.

items.title: NVDA closes Nov 12 at $166.19 (−4.34%) after Huang’s resignation
items.summary: Nvidia 11 月 12 日收市報 $166.19，跌 4.34%，成交量遠高於平均。Motley Fool 指股價喺黃仁勳辭任消息後顯著波動，盤中跌幅一度更深，收市前有所收窄；公司將於 11 月 17 日公布業績。
items.note: publishedAt is the official U.S. regular-session close (16:00 ET on Nov 12). The Motley Fool article timestamp is 21:58 UTC.
items.imageAlt: Motley Fool market image accompanying the Nov 12 Nvidia close report

items.title: AMD closes Nov 12 at $585.30 (+5.86%) as investors rotate in chip peers
items.summary: AMD 11 月 12 日收市報 $585.30，升 5.86%。Motley Fool 指資金喺 Nvidia 領導層動盪後流向其他半導體同業，並且 Bank of America 將 AMD 目標價由 $650 上調至 $700。
items.note: publishedAt is the official U.S. regular-session close (16:00 ET on Nov 12). The Motley Fool article timestamp is 22:00 UTC.
items.imageAlt: Motley Fool market image accompanying the Nov 12 AMD close report

items.title: AVGO closes Nov 12 at $364.36 (+5.54%) alongside other AI chip names
items.summary: Broadcom 11 月 12 日收市報 $364.36，升 5.54%。同一篇 Motley Fool 市場報道指，投資者喺 Nvidia 當日下跌後轉向其他 AI 芯片股。
items.note: AVGO’s close is reported in the Motley Fool Nov 12 Nvidia market wrap. publishedAt is the official U.S. regular-session close (16:00 ET on Nov 12).
items.imageAlt: Motley Fool market image accompanying the Nov 12 semiconductor close report

items.title: MSFT closes Nov 12 at $523.00 (+0.36%)
items.summary: Microsoft 11 月 12 日收市報 $523.00，升 0.36%；StockAnalysis 顯示盤後報 $521.50。數據來源標明為 S&P Global Market Intelligence。
items.note: publishedAt is the official U.S. regular-session close (16:00 ET on Nov 12). The site og:image is a generic logo, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: GOOGL closes Nov 12 at $298.70 (+1.8%), per a report citing CNBC
items.summary: The Company Chronicle 引述 CNBC，指 Alphabet 11 月 12 日升 1.8% 至 $298.70。報道將升幅放喺 Nvidia 領導層變動當日、資金輪動至其他 AI 相關股份嘅背景。
items.note: Close is reported as $298.70, up 1.8%, citing CNBC; not independently confirmed from a primary quote page. publishedAt is the official U.S. regular-session close (16:00 ET on Nov 12). The article timestamp is 4:55 PM ET.
items.imageAlt: The Company Chronicle chart image for the Nov 12 U.S. market close

items.title: Nebius shares fall about 16% after a weaker 2026 outlook and higher capex plans
items.summary: The Next Web 報道，AI 雲公司 Nebius 公布業績後股價跌約 16%。報道引述 CNBC 指第三季收入 9.808 億美元、按年升 571%，但因租用數據中心延誤，2026 年收入展望指向 $30 億至 $34 億區間低端；今年資本開支上調至約 $270 億，2027 年計劃 $400 億至 $450 億。
items.note: TNW’s 16% figure is from a 7:34 PM GMT article, before the U.S. close. The Company Chronicle later cited a close of $128.64 (−16.8%); that exact close is not used here because it is from a second source.
items.imageAlt: Nebius founder and CEO Arkady Volozh speaking on stage

items.title: Commandos: Origins Deluxe Edition coming to Switch 2 on December 15
items.summary: Kalypso Media 宣布，《Commandos: Origins Deluxe Edition》會喺 12 月 15 日以 59.99 美元登陸 Switch 2，支援 Joy-Con 2 滑鼠操作、GameChat，同線上或本地分屏雙人合作。豪華版包埋本體、六套造型同原聲帶；兩套後續 DLC 亦會喺發售當日分開發售，每個 14.99 美元。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp 2:35 PM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 03:35 HKT on 13 November.
items.imageAlt: Commandos: Origins Deluxe Edition Switch 2 announcement art from Gematsu

items.title: Herdling Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is out now as a free upgrade
items.summary: Panic 同 Okomotive 已經推出《Herdling》Switch 2 Edition，有更高解像度同幀率，原本 Switch 版玩家可以免費升級。未買過嘅人可以喺限時半價買 Switch 版之後，再免費升上 Switch 2 版；遊戲本來已經喺 PS5、Xbox Series 同 PC 推出。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp 12:03 PM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 01:03 HKT on 13 November. Official store: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/herdling-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/
items.imageAlt: Herdling Nintendo Switch 2 Edition announcement art from Gematsu

items.title: KuloNiku: Bowl Up! dated November 25 for Switch 2 and Switch
items.summary: 發行商 Raw Fury 同開發組 Gambir Studio 宣布，烹飪遊戲《KuloNiku: Bowl Up!》會喺 11 月 25 日登陸 Switch 2 同 Switch。遊戲 4 月已經喺 Steam 推出，玩家要接手奶奶間肉丸餐廳，一邊煮食一邊同對手打烹飪對決。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp 11:24 AM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 00:24 HKT on 13 November.
items.imageAlt: KuloNiku: Bowl Up! Switch announcement art from Gematsu

items.title: DERELIKT listed to launch November 13 on Steam
items.summary: Visuwyg 開發、Hyperstrange 發行嘅復古科幻恐怖第一身射擊《DERELIKT》，Steam 列出 11 月 13 日登陸 PC，之後先會出 PS5 同 Xbox Series。遊戲背景喺土星軌道一個廢棄研究站，風格係偏壓迫感嘅 PS1 年代科幻恐怖。
items.note: Date-only publishedAt from the live Steam listing, which was still coming_soon on the morning of 13 November 2026 HKT (the Americas were still on 12 November evening). Gematsu dated the PC launch 13 November on 20 October 2026, with PS5 and Xbox Series to follow later: https://www.gematsu.com/2026/10/derelikt-launches-november-13-for-pc-later-for-ps5-and-xbox-series
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for DERELIKT

items.title: GRIME II coming to Switch 2 and Switch on November 27, with A Final Coda update
items.summary: 發行商 Kwalee 同開發組 Clover Bite 宣布，類魂 Metroidvania 續作《GRIME II》會喺 11 月 27 日登陸 Switch 2 同 Switch，並同步為現有平台推出免費更新 “A Final Coda”。呢個更新會喺通關之後解鎖新區域同頭目再戰系統，為前作留下嘅故事線作結；遊戲 3 月已經喺 PS5、Xbox Series 同 PC 推出。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp 11:00 AM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 00:00 HKT on 13 November.
items.imageAlt: GRIME II Switch announcement art from Gematsu

items.title: Station to Station coming to Switch 2 and PS5 on November 26
items.summary: 發行商 Engine Software 同開發組 Galaxy Grove 宣布，體素風格鐵路解謎《Station to Station》會喺 11 月 26 日登陸 Switch 2 同 PS5，售價 17.99 美元／歐元，Nintendo eShop 而家開放預購並有八折發售優惠。遊戲 2023 年已經喺 Steam 推出。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp 9:07 AM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 22:07 HKT the same day.
items.imageAlt: Station to Station console announcement art from Gematsu

items.title: Supermarket Simulator launches digitally on Switch 2 and PS5
items.summary: 發行商 Silver Lining Interactive 同 Nokta Games 確認，《Supermarket Simulator》已經喺 11 月 12 日以數位版登陸 Switch 2 同 PS5，Nintendo 美國商店顯示售價 19.99 美元而且標咗 Available now。包埋七個 DLC 嘅 Fully Stocked 實體版就排喺 12 月 4 日推出，Switch 2 係 Game Key Card。
items.note: Date-only publishedAt from the official US store listing, which shows Available now. This launch was not in the 12 November batch. Publisher announcement and GoNintendo also confirm the 12 November digital PS5/Switch 2 debut; the Fully Stocked physical edition is dated 4 December 2026.
items.imageAlt: Official Nintendo eShop artwork for Supermarket Simulator on Switch 2

items.title: Adorable Adventures is out now digitally on Switch 2
items.summary: PQube 同 Wild Sheep Studio 宣布，溫馨探索遊戲《Adorable Adventures》已經喺 11 月 12 日以數位版登陸 Switch 2，即日起至 11 月 26 日有八折。實體版排喺 2027 年 1 月 28 日推出；遊戲 4 月已經喺 PC、PS5 同 Xbox Series 出過。
items.note: Date-only publishedAt from the Games Press launch release dated 12 November 2026. Hero image is from GoNintendo’s same-day launch post. Physical edition dated 2027-01-28.
items.imageAlt: Adorable Adventures artwork of baby boar Boris

items.title: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon enters Steam Early Access
items.summary: Falling Damage Games 嘅滑雪場經營模擬《Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon》已經喺 11 月 12 日登陸 Steam Early Access，支援 Windows、Mac，亦都標明可以喺 Steam Deck 玩。定價 19.99 美元，發售期間有九折；開發組話之後會再加更多山區同夏季活動。
items.note: Date-only publishedAt from the Games Press release dated 12 November 2026. Steam app 4493130 confirms the game is already released, with a current discounted price of $17.99 at research time.

items.title: Hazard Levels leaves Early Access with a 1.0 launch on PC, PS5 and Xbox
items.summary: Wales Interactive 宣布，合作生存恐怖遊戲《Hazard Levels》已經喺 11 月 12 日結束 Early Access，1.0 版登陸 Steam、Epic、PS5 同 Xbox Series。1 至 4 人合作闖入不穩定裂縫搵材料，1.0 仲加咗新外觀、Rift Bestiary 同更難預測嘅 Rift Surges。
items.note: Date-only publishedAt; the official Wix post did not expose a precise timestamp. Steam store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374680/Hazard_Levels/

items.title: Xbox brings 21 more original Xbox games to PC, taking the backward-compat library to 25
items.summary: Xbox 宣布再有 21 款初代 Xbox 遊戲經向後兼容登陸 PC，令呢個 PC 遊戲庫增至 25 款，包括《The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind》、《TimeSplitters 2》同多款《Star Wars》作品，需要 Windows 11。另外，《KOTOR》系列、《BLiNX》同《Conker: Live and Reloaded》首次加入成就，主機版更新之後一樣適用。
items.note: Xbox Wire article:published_time is 2026-11-12T21:02:29+00:00, which is 2026-11-13T05:02:29+08:00. Some outlets shortened the headline to “adds 21 titles”; the official post is clear that 21 new games bring the PC library to 25.
items.imageAlt: Xbox Wire artwork for original Xbox games arriving on PC

items.title: Nintendo announces US Black Friday Switch 2 bundle and game discounts
items.summary: 任天堂公布美國黑色星期五優惠：11 月 22 日至 12 月 5 日，Switch 2 加《Mario Kart World》同三個月 Switch Online 個人會籍組合售 499.99 美元，減 50 美元。11 月 22 日至 29 日，包括《Donkey Kong Bananza》、《Kirby Air Riders》同《Metroid Prime 4: Beyond》Switch 2 版在內嘅指定遊戲減 20 美元；eShop 同官方商店數位減價就由 11 月 19 日進行至 12 月 2 日。
items.note: Prices and dates verified against Nintendo’s official US post dated 11/12/26: https://www.nintendo.com/us/whatsnew/nintendo-announces-black-friday-offers-to-help-spread-joy-this-holiday-season/ . Official og:image is only a generic social-share graphic, so this item uses Polygon’s same-day report (published 10:20 AM EST / 15:20:59 UTC) and hero image. The official post also lists a Switch 2 + Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Bundle at $529.99 ($27.98 off).
items.imageAlt: Mario Kart World gameplay screenshot on Nintendo Switch 2

items.title: Ocarina of Time remake opens at 537,041 physical sales in Japan, Famitsu says
items.summary: Famitsu 公布日本 11 月 2 日至 8 日實體銷量：《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》Switch 2 重製版首週賣出 537,041 套，係當週最高。對照任天堂較早前公布嘅日本 81 萬套總銷量，Gematsu 估計當中約 27.3 萬套係數位版。同期 Switch 2 主機賣出 53,104 部。
items.note: Genuine new regional physical split after the already-covered 5.2 million worldwide / 810,000 Japan four-day announcement. The ~273,000 digital figure is Gematsu’s estimate (Nintendo’s 810,000 minus Famitsu’s 537,041 physical), not a Nintendo disclosure. Gematsu 8:04 AM EST on 12 November converts to 21:04 HKT.
items.imageAlt: Gematsu Famitsu sales chart graphic for the week of November 2–8, 2026

items.title: Nintendo will end Google and Apple sign-ins for Nintendo Accounts on January 26, 2027
items.summary: 任天堂將喺 2027 年 1 月 26 日起，停用以 Google 或 Apple 帳戶登入或新開 Nintendo Account 嘅方法，同時取消連結 Google 帳戶嚟賺 My Nintendo 白金點數嘅任務。官方叫玩家喺截止日期前設定密碼或通行密鑰，確實停止時間會視乎系統轉換進度。
items.note: Engadget article:published_time is 2026-11-12T11:19:46+00:00 (19:19:46 HKT). Official support page: https://www.nintendo.com/au/support/articles/discontinuation-of-google-and-apple-accounts-linking-to-nintendo-accounts/
items.imageAlt: Engadget article image for Nintendo ending Google and Apple sign-ins

items.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam opens PS5 and PC pre-orders, reveals voice cast
items.summary: LEVEL-5 宣布，《雷頓教授與蒸氣之新世界》已經開放 PS5 同 Steam 數位預購，售價 64.99 美元，遊戲 12 月 10 日推出；Switch 2 同 Switch 預購會稍後開始。預購送 11 首系列原聲，官方亦公布多語配音陣容，英語版雷頓教授由 Christopher Robin Miller 配音。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp 6:00 AM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 19:00 HKT the same day. Switch 2/Switch versions are confirmed but their pre-orders are not open yet.
items.imageAlt: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam pre-order announcement art from Gematsu

items.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United moved up to February 4, 2027
items.summary: Square Enix 將《Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United》嘅推出日由 2027 年 2 月 16 日提前至 2 月 4 日，平台包括 PS5、Xbox Series、Switch 2、Switch，同埋 Steam 同 Microsoft Store 嘅 PC 版。呢套係 1995 年作品嘅全 3D 重製，戰鬥會保留閃技同陣型，並加入時間軸系統。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp 2:08 AM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 15:08 HKT the same day.
items.imageAlt: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United release-date announcement art from Gematsu

items.title: Valve’s redesigned Steam Achievement Sets are now live for all users
items.summary: Valve 將 Steam 成就系統改版全面推出：成就可以分成基礎遊戲同 DLC 套組，季節性成就完結之後唔會再卡住 100% 完成度，亦都可以同最多三位朋友比較進度。呢次用戶端更新同時改善 Remote Play 嘅 HDR、將 Linux 用戶端改為 64 位，並加強 Big Picture 傾偈功能。
items.note: Date-only publishedAt; PCGamesN lists Published: November 12, 2026 without a precise timestamp. Valve also has a Steam news post at https://store.steampowered.com/news/posts/4149575031735702629
items.imageAlt: PCGamesN article image for the Steam Achievement Sets client update

items.title: Once Human Season 5: Dissonant Resonance arrives November 18 on PS5
items.summary: PlayStation 官方博客宣布免費遊玩嘅《Once Human》第五季「Dissonant Resonance」會喺 11 月 18 日登陸 PS5，加入四人合作 Colossus Raid、四個情感區域，同埋新 Deviant 夥伴 Silent Statue。
items.note: This official post only confirms the season drop on PS5. Do not infer other platforms. Timestamp 2026-11-12T15:00:19-08:00 converts to 2026-11-13T07:00:19+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Once Human Season 5 Dissonant Resonance Colossus artwork

items.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages Revelations adds Slaughter Mode on November 16
items.summary: Bethesda 同 id Software 宣布《DOOM: The Dark Ages》付費 DLC「Revelations」會喺 11 月 16 日推出免費更新，加入無盡戰鬥模式 Slaughter Mode。擁有該 DLC、Premium 版或者 Premium Upgrade 嘅玩家都唔使再畀錢。
items.note: Official Bethesda post is the primary source for the mode and date (datetime 2026-11-12T20:00:00Z). Its fetched og:image was only a generic Slayers Club logo, so imageUrl is the Gematsu article hero for the same announcement. Platforms are stated on the Gematsu write-up: https://www.gematsu.com/2026/11/doom-the-dark-ages-dlc-revelations-slaughter-mode-update-launches-november-16
items.imageAlt: DOOM: The Dark Ages Slaughter Mode announcement art

items.title: Fable shows new quest gameplay for Xbox’s 25th anniversary, still due February 23, 2027
items.summary: 為慶祝 Xbox 25 周年，Playground Games 公開咗約四分鐘《Fable》重啟作任務遊玩片段，講述 Hero of Briar Hill 同 Arden 調查 Oakshire 附近被污染嘅魔法。遊戲仍然訂於 2027 年 2 月 23 日登陸 PS5、Xbox Series 同 PC，亦會上 Game Pass。
items.note: The February 23, 2027 date is restated in this Nov 12 coverage rather than newly dated; the new development is the four-minute quest gameplay video. Gematsu timestamp 2:51 PM EST converts to 03:51 HKT on 13 November.
items.imageAlt: Fable reboot Xbox 25th anniversary quest gameplay still

items.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting Firefight in a free winter update
items.summary: Xbox 官方宣布《Halo: Campaign Evolved》今個冬天會以免費更新加入四人合作 PvE 模式 Firefight。Xbox FanFest 參加者當日已經可以試玩；更多詳情會喺 12 月 12 至 13 日西雅圖 Halo Fest 公布，確切推出日期暫時未定。
items.note: Winter 2026 free update; exact date TBA, more details at Halo Fest Dec 12–13. Platforms taken from the same Xbox Wire page (console and PC, with console-only split-screen).
items.imageAlt: Halo: Campaign Evolved Firefight promotional art

items.title: Zero Hour launches December 3 on PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: 開發商 AttritoM7 宣布戰術射擊《Zero Hour》會喺 12 月 3 日登陸 PS5 同 Xbox Series，售價 24.99 美元。主機版支援完整跨平台、最多 10 人網上合作，而且會附送六款武器外觀包。
items.note: Already on PC; this item is the dated PS5/Xbox Series launch. Gematsu timestamp 9:34 AM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 22:34 HKT the same day.
items.imageAlt: Zero Hour console release announcement artwork

items.title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves DLC fighter Laocorn Gaudeamus dated November 19
items.summary: SNK 宣布《Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves》第三季 DLC 角色 Laocorn Gaudeamus 會喺 11 月 19 日推出。佢係 1994 年動畫電影《Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture》嘅主要反派，遊戲現已喺 PS5、Xbox Series、Switch 2、PS4 同 PC 推出。
items.note: Gematsu timestamp 9:22 AM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 22:22 HKT the same day. Official SNK US press is dated 2026-11-12.
items.imageAlt: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves DLC character Laocorn Gaudeamus

items.title: Elements Destiny dated December 8 for PS5, Xbox, PS4, Xbox One and PC; Switch on December 15
items.summary: Deck13 Spotlight 宣布 2D 奇幻 RPG《Elements Destiny》會喺 12 月 8 日登陸 PS5、Xbox Series、PS4、Xbox One 同 PC，Switch 版就喺 12 月 15 日推出。
items.note: Switch date is December 15, 2026; other listed platforms are December 8. Source says Switch, not Switch 2. Gematsu timestamp 9:13 AM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 22:13 HKT the same day.
items.imageAlt: Elements Destiny release date announcement artwork

items.title: Vindictus: Defying Fate confirmed for PS5, launching in 2027
items.summary: NEXON 確認中世紀動作 RPG《Vindictus: Defying Fate》會喺 2027 年登陸 PS5，同 Steam 版一齊推出。完整預告訂於 11 月 13 日首播，確切發行日期暫時未公布。
items.note: Launch year is 2027; exact date TBA. Gematsu timestamp 3:15 AM EST on 12 November 2026 converts to 16:15 HKT the same day. Full trailer was scheduled to premiere later on Nov 13.
items.imageAlt: Vindictus Defying Fate cinematic trailer teaser art

items.title: Palworld studio Pocketpair gives staff a five-day leave when GTA 6 launches
items.summary: 《Palworld》開發商 Pocketpair 宣布，11 月 19 至 23 日會畀打算玩《GTA 6》嘅員工放特別假，自稱去 Vice City 出五日本差。公司同時話《Palworld》同《Craftopia》嘅更新會如期進行。
items.note: Platforms refer to GTA 6 as named in the article (launch November 19). The article does not list Palworld or Craftopia platforms. Published 2026-11-12T22:08:48Z.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI promotional still used in the PC Gamer report

items.title: id Software confirms it is already working on its next game, directed by Hugo Martin
items.summary: Xbox 同 id Software 確認工作室已經由 Texas 同 Frankfurt 團隊開展下一款新作，遊戲總監再次由 Hugo Martin 擔任，但暫時未公布類型、平台同檔期。呢個消息係喺工作室早前受裁員影響之後公布。
items.note: VGC byline is 9:38 pm on 12 Nov 2026, treated as UK time (GMT in mid-November) = 2026-11-13T05:38:00+08:00. Platforms for the new game are unannounced, so omitted.
items.imageAlt: id Software studio sign

items.title: SensorTower estimates GTA 6 has already passed $1.09 billion in presales
items.summary: USA Today 引述 SensorTower 數據，估計《GTA VI》未推出已經錄得 1,127 萬套預購、約 10.9 億美元收入，當中 PS5 佔 75%、Xbox Series 佔 25%。遊戲訂於 11 月 19 日推出；呢啲係第三方估計，唔係 Take-Two 官方公布嘅數字。
items.note: Uncertain because the $1.09 billion and 11.27 million figures are SensorTower estimates reported by USA Today (Nov. 12, 2026, 12:12 p.m. ET), not an official Take-Two disclosure. Genuine numerical update versus earlier coverage of record pre-orders. USA Today also says the standard physical box contains a download code rather than a disc.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI characters Jason and Lucia

items.title: Disney+ will livestream The Game Awards 2026 on December 10
items.summary: Disney+ 宣布會喺 12 月 10 日晚上 7:30（美東時間）直播 The Game Awards 2026，美國同部分海外地區都睇到。官方話當晚會有 Disney 遊戲相關嘅重大公布，頒獎禮亦會繼續喺 YouTube、Twitch 等平台直播。
items.note: Disney metadata is midnight Pacific on Nov 12 (2026-11-12T00:00:00.000-08:00), so publishedAt is date-based at 16:00 HKT. Variety stamped the same announcement at 9:00 a.m. PT (2026-11-13T01:00:00+08:00). No specific game platforms are named.
items.imageAlt: The Game Awards on Disney+ key art

items.title: Paradox Interactive names Mattias Lilja CEO effective January 4, 2027
items.summary: Paradox Interactive 董事會任命現任副行政總裁 Mattias Lilja 由 2027 年 1 月 4 日起出任 CEO，接替決定轉任董事、專注長遠發展嘅 Fredrik Wester。Wester 會留任至交接完成，並且仍然係公司最大股東。
items.note: Published 18:25 CET on 11 November 2026, which is 2026-11-12T01:25:00+08:00, after the Nov 11 batch cutoff and not in prior batches. Platforms set to PC because the official release names Cities: Skylines, Hearts of Iron IV and Stellaris.
items.imageAlt: Paradox Interactive logo
